lede: Columbus had last change, so Rick Bowness picked most of these matchups. Columbus played without Carson Soucy and Dmitri Voronkov. The Rangers played without Cole Beaudoin and Jaroslav Chmelař.

notes.head: The third line drew Dorofeyev’s line
notes.text: Rick Bowness sent Sillinger, Coyle and Olivier out for 10:11 of their 12:39 at 5-on-5 against Kartye, Miller and Dorofeyev (81%, about 30% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.38 to 0.17 expected goals.

notes.head: Knies’s line drew Zibanejad’s line
notes.text: Knies, Fantilli and Johnson spent 10:47 of their 16:06 at 5-on-5 against Perreault, Zibanejad and Lafrenière (67%, about 36% with no line matching), and they had the better of the chances, 0.33 to 0.13 expected goals.

notes.head: Nichushkin’s line drew Cuylle’s line
notes.text: Nichushkin, Monahan and Garland spent 6:11 of their 12:18 at 5-on-5 against Cuylle, Laba and Tolvanen (50%, about 20% with no line matching), and they had the worse of the chances, 0.16 to 0.60 expected goals.

notes.head: One matchup went wrong
notes.text: Nichushkin, Monahan and Garland kept drawing the Rangers’ first line, Perreault, Zibanejad and Lafrenière. In those 3:46 the Rangers had 0.62 expected goals to Columbus’s 0.02.

foot: Rick Bowness matched harder than in his other home games: each line spent 64% of its time against one opposing line, against 37% to 57% in his first four.
